#!/usr/bin/env bash
# vLLM OpenAI-compatible server used by bench/study.py. Each result file stores this script.
#   --dtype float16            the checkpoint is BF16; FP16 matches Ollama's F16 GGUF
#   --max-model-len 2048       same per-request context as Ollama's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
#   --max-num-seqs 16          at most 16 sequences in a batch, same as OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
#   --generation-config vllm   ignore the checkpoint's sampling defaults (repetition_penalty 1.1)
#   --no-enable-prefix-caching  caching off on both servers (Ollama: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0); the
#                               client's per-request tag would defeat it anyway
set -euo pipefail
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
exec "$HOME/llmbench/venv/bin/vllm" serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct \
  --revision 989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306 \
  --served-model-name qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct \
  --dtype float16 \
  --max-model-len 2048 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.80 \
  --generation-config vllm \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --seed 0 \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Ollama server used by bench/study.py (user-space install from scripts/setup_ollama.sh).
#   OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=16      16 request slots, so it can batch up to the highest concurrency
#   OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=2048  per-request context, same as vLLM --max-model-len
#   port 11435                  keeps clear of the Windows Ollama app on 11434
#   LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0       turns off llama-server's host-RAM prompt cache. Its default 8 GiB limit
#                               is more than this WSL instance's 7.6 GB of RAM, and the workload gives it
#                               nothing to reuse (see results/aborted/attempt2_1c2d0a3/NOTE.md)
# Everything else (flash attention, KV cache type f16) stays at Ollama's defaults.
set -euo pipefail
export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11435
export OLLAMA_MODELS="$HOME/llmbench/ollama-models"
export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=16
export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=2048
export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1
export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1
export OLLAMA_NOHISTORY=1
export LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0
exec "$HOME/llmbench/ollama/bin/ollama" serve

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# vLLM OpenAI-compatible server used by bench/study.py. Each result file stores this script.
#   --dtype float16            the checkpoint is BF16; FP16 matches Ollama's F16 GGUF
#   --max-model-len 2048       same per-request context as Ollama's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
#   --max-num-seqs 16          at most 16 sequences in a batch, same as OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
#   --generation-config vllm   ignore the checkpoint's sampling defaults (repetition_penalty 1.1)
#   --no-enable-prefix-caching  caching off on both servers (Ollama: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0); the
#                               client's per-request tag would defeat it anyway
set -euo pipefail
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
exec "$HOME/llmbench/venv/bin/vllm" serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct \
  --revision 989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306 \
  --served-model-name qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct \
  --dtype float16 \
  --max-model-len 2048 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.80 \
  --generation-config vllm \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --seed 0 \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Ollama server used by bench/study.py (user-space install from scripts/setup_ollama.sh).
#   OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=16      16 request slots, so it can batch up to the highest concurrency
#   OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=2048  per-request context, same as vLLM --max-model-len
#   port 11435                  keeps clear of the Windows Ollama app on 11434
#   LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0       turns off llama-server's host-RAM prompt cache. Its default 8 GiB limit
#                               is more than this WSL instance's 7.6 GB of RAM, and the workload gives it
#                               nothing to reuse (see results/aborted/attempt2_1c2d0a3/NOTE.md)
# Everything else (flash attention, KV cache type f16) stays at Ollama's defaults.
set -euo pipefail
export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11435
export OLLAMA_MODELS="$HOME/llmbench/ollama-models"
export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=16
export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=2048
export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1
export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1
export OLLAMA_NOHISTORY=1
export LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0
exec "$HOME/llmbench/ollama/bin/ollama" serve
